responsibility: Central implementation of C-family attribute semantics. This file registers and validates GNU/C/ObjC/C++ attributes on declarations, types, statements, and builtins; applies their effects to GCC tree nodes and symbol properties; diagnoses misuse and conflicting combinations; and implements helper queries such as __builtin_has_attribute, transactional-memory attribute handling, sanitizer-related attributes, visibility/section/alignment attributes, and many other declaration/type annotations shared across the C-family front ends.
